get.summary: Resolve a programmatic landing page by its path
get.description: Takes the raw path, e.g. /jee-coaching-in-pune, because only the database can decide whether "online-jee" is mode ONLINE plus exam "jee" or an exam slugged exactly that. Returns listings, the parent total that decides the canonical, set-wide fee stats and sibling links. 404 when the path is not a landing URL, when the exam or city is unknown, or when no listings match.

get.summary: List landing paths eligible for indexing
get.description: Only combinations at or above LANDING_MIN_INDEXABLE. Feeds the sitemap, which must never list a noindex URL.

Columns are institutes; each pins one upcoming published batch, defaulting to the cheapest. A stale slug is dropped and reported in `dropped` rather than failing the request, and a stale pin falls back to the default with `pinFellBack` set — both are the expected fate of a shared link. A pin naming another institute’s published batch is a 400, because it cannot arise from the UI or from the passage of time. Former slugs are resolved into `canonicalSlugs`; this route never answers 301, because fetch would consume it before the browser could act (BUG-001).
